annotations.description: The last 24 hours used {{ printf "%.1f" $values.B.Value }} kWh, {{ humanizePercentage $values.A.Value }} of the previous week's daily average. Something may have been left running - check Power by meter on the dashboard.

sum(avg_over_time((((smartlife_power_watts{name=~"Server|Desktop|Office|TV and Audio|Internet and Den|NerdQaxe\\+\\+"} and on(device_id) smartlife_voltage_volts < 300) or smartlife_power_watts_history{name=~"Server|Desktop|Office|TV and Audio|Internet and Den|NerdQaxe\\+\\+"} or smartlife_power_watts_estimate{name=~"Server|Desktop|Office|TV and Audio|Internet and Den|NerdQaxe\\+\\+"}) + 0)[24h:5m])) * 24 / 1000
